description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the AuthProviderChain class in the OrangeHRM authentication module. It tests various scenarios of authentication provider chaining, including adding providers, resolving authentication among multiple providers based on priority, and handling duplicate provider registration.

classes.name: AuthProviderChainTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the functionality of the AuthProviderChain class, including provider addition and authentication resolution.

classes.name: DebugAuthProvider
classes.description: Mock implementation of an authentication provider with fixed priority, always returns true for authentication.

classes.name: LocalAuthProvider
classes.description: Mock implementation representing a local authentication provider with configurable priority.

classes.name: LDAPAuthProvider
classes.description: Mock LDAP authentication provider with configurable priority.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithOneProvider
methods.description: Tests authentication with a single provider in the chain, expecting false as the provider always returns false.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithMultipleProvidersResolvingFirstProvider
methods.description: Tests chain where the first provider (with highest priority) authenticates successfully, expecting true.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithMultipleProvidersResolvingSecondProvider
methods.description: Tests chain where the second provider authenticates successfully after the first fails, expecting true.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithMultipleProvidersResolvingLastProvider
methods.description: Tests chain where the last provider authenticates successfully after preceding providers fail, expecting true.

methods.name: testAddProviderWithMultipleProvidersWithSamePriority
methods.description: Ensures adding multiple providers with the same priority raises an InvalidArgumentException.

methods.name: testAddProvider
methods.description: Tests adding a duplicate provider instance raises an exception.
